items.title: Ray Bauduc Interview, 1984-06-27
items.q: I'll tell you about that out, Bucket.

ctx.x: Uh, I hear, I hear the brass band still play that bugle part. You know, the trumpet will take the bugle part.
Well, anyway, I, if I had a record I could show you. I'll tell you about that out, Bucket.
Yeah, I'll, I'll have to play you a record of it someday. What, what drummers had good roles, you know, could play a nice press role?
